label: RESOURCE-LOCK-GUARDIAN-HARDENING
title: Keep resource ownership after the visible supervisor is SIGKILLed
scope: Close the fail-open case where SIGKILL of the visible resource-lock Bash releases guard ownership while its child continues after closing inherited guard descriptors.

validation.syntax: bash parse and Python compile without bytecode output
validation.regression: isolated SIGKILL of outer wrapper while a no-guard-FD task remains alive must keep status BUSY and block acquisition until task exit
validation.existing: all T-025 isolated lock tests remain green

acceptance: No task starts before the pidfd lease keeper readiness handshake; SIGKILL of the visible Bash or primary guardian alone cannot release the lock while the real task root is alive; normal exit code and cleanup remain correct.
resource: Isolated lightweight self-test only; never fault-inject against production lock owners.
